Provides Radix theme tokens, responsive layout utilities, and component styles.

# Purpose
This stylesheet defines the visual system for a web user interface by setting global theme values, font settings, colors, spacing, and layout rules. It loads font faces and defines CSS custom properties and component tokens for light and dark modes, accent color sets, and display support across different color spaces and browser capabilities. It also includes rules for Radix Themes components, utility classes, responsive breakpoints, and page-level elements such as `#app` and `body`, so the application can use one shared style source for text, controls, panels, charts, tooltips, and other interface parts.
